IntegrationRequestConflict.description: Identity reused for different input/operation, uncertain pending outcome, expired identity or unavailable result. The effect is never dispatched again on replay.

ManagementOrigin.name: Origin
ManagementOrigin.description: Required for all management writes and must match the workspace origin. Browsers supply this header automatically.

IntegrationWriteOrigin.name: Origin
IntegrationWriteOrigin.description: Required for PairedDevice writes, together with the paired CSRF credential. IntegrationBearer needs neither; a supplied disallowed Origin or cross-site Fetch Metadata is still refused.

IntegrationBearer.description: Owner/source-bound integration credential. Only contracts whose x-scopes intersect its grants admit it. Never send tokens in URLs. Every admitted write requires its x-request-identity body field. Identity is scoped to owner and token; changed validated input or operation conflicts. Completed requests replay the first status with the current result projection, without invoking the effect again. Pending outcomes are uncertain and replay as 409. Result data expires after 24 hours; permanent credential-lifetime markers refuse old keys with 409.

PairedDevice.name: Cookie
PairedDevice.description: Complete Cookie header from the paired device session, including cookie names. Preserve the deployment's names and values (__Host-loop on HTTPS, loop_local on local HTTP, with an installation suffix for isolated previews; existing __Host-loop and loop_local cookies remain accepted). Browsers attach their cookie jar automatically; non-browser clients supply the complete header value. Management writes also require PairedCsrf.

PairedCsrf.name: x-loop-csrf
PairedCsrf.description: Required together with PairedDevice for management writes. Read the csrf value from the authenticated /session response. Also send the matching workspace Origin header.
